annotations.title: Show the NaRabotu form in the chat

description: Shows an interactive NaRabotu posting form in the chat for a job seeker’s "looking for work" profile (kind="seek") or an employer’s vacancy (kind="job"), pre-filled with the given values. The user completes it, confirms with a code from e-mail and publishes without leaving the chat.

locale.description: Language of names and links (default ru).

prefill.description: Known field values, using the posting form field names (e.g. city, professions, display_name, title, description, email, employer).

name: open_form
